title: oncoba paludosa
intro: Oncoba paludosa, commonly known as Swamp Mangrove, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Oncoba paludosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
